title: Set IMS Service Config Request
description: Backs taf_radio_SetImsSvcCfg(imsRef, ImsSvcType service, bool enable) -- taf_radio.api's ImsSvcType enum values (IMS_SVC_TYPE_IMS_REG/SMS/VOIP/RTT/VONR) map 1:1 to IImsSettingsManager: IMS_REG/SMS/VOIP/RTT each set one bit of ImsServiceConfig (imsServiceEnabled/smsEnabled/voImsEnabled/rttEnabled) via setServiceConfig's configValidityMask; VONR instead calls the dedicated toggleVonr, per the SDK exposing VoNR as its own API distinct from the generic service-config bitset.
